$comment: C31 instance-data constraint hints (design R9). The generator derives most constraints from the model itself: array bounds from EA cardinality (task 4.3.1) and if/then/else conditionals from the condition markers in espd-edm.json (task 4.3.2). Only what the model cannot express is hand-authored here.
$todo: Remaining hints and why they are still here: 'minimum' needs value bounds (min/max) carried on the upstream datatype definitions (task 4.3.3, requires an EA/ResponseDataType addition); 'optionalLeaves' is a genuine implementation decision that CONTRADICTS the EA cardinality and must stay a projection decision (task 4.3.4).

leafConstraints.$note: Per-leaf refinements merged into the generated shape, keyed by semantic ID. minItems on lotIdentifiers is no longer needed — it is derived from the 1..n cardinality.

optionalLeaves.$note: Leaves whose EA cardinality is required (1) but which the reference implementation models as OPTIONAL. Cannot be derived: it contradicts the EA model.
